title: Openrouter has as new (frontier) mystery model stealth/ox-alpha on free trial. Can it trade?
author: Ok-Draft2744
selftext:
You can use the [model for free](https://openrouter.ai/stealth/ox-alpha) for now to try it out. I am wondering how well it performs in trading. It is really new and so far it had only made 1 trade, avoiding the recent spike in crypto activity   
  
I've used it for a bit for coding and it doesn't seem as strong as Claude or GPT, maybe it is similar to their previous fusion model, which dynamically picks which model to use. Either way, I see some of the open-weight models perform better than the top frontier models

comments.author: fomoz
comments.body: Where are you using it to trade?

replies.author: Ok-Draft2744
replies.body: The above is paper trading results. I wouldn't use a new model for trading right away, otherwise mostly HL

replies.author: fomoz
replies.body: You built a platform to trade on HL? What is it?

replies.author: Ok-Draft2744
replies.body: Its my own setup, nothing fancy, just a bunch of ai driven decision loops + a few backtested algos. I've been experimenting for several months now and still can't find a winning formula. Not sure if your question was on the specifics of the platform, market data, ai/code decision separations etc.
